scope: Input mapping for real scoped MCP calls. Direct protocol execution proves tool behavior only; semantic no-tool negative cases require an actual assistant session. Repeated arguments deliberately assess distinct output interpretation, not additional unique runtime inputs.

positive.prompt: Busca datasets de vivienda en datos.gob.es con hasta seis registros.
positive.expected_behavior: Call compare_spanish_open_datasets using the concrete identifiers, filters and bounds in the prompt. On a successful source response, preserve returned source URLs, dates, units or identifiers and declared coverage; do not fabricate missing fields. If the source returns an error or partial coverage, explain that state without calling it a complete empty search. Search datos.gob.es catalog metadata by term and page; compare publishers, formats, licences and gaps without claiming distributions were inspected.
